svg.title: With Syfert's tools, misgrounded citations fall to 2–6% for every model tested

cc:Work.dc:title: With Syfert's tools, misgrounded citations fall to 2–6% for every model tested
cc:Work.dc:description: Sonnet 5 + Syfert: misgrounded 1.9%, fabricated 0.8% of 264 cites; Gemma 4 26B local + Syfert: misgrounded 2.8%, fabricated 0.7% of 288 cites; DeepSeek 4.1 Flash + Syfert: misgrounded 3.2%, fabricated 0.0% of 277 cites; Claude Fable 5.1 (Claude Code) + Syfert: misgrounded 3.4%, fabricated 0.3% of 387 cites; Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) + Syfert: misgrounded 4.7%, fabricated 0.4% of 258 cites; Qwen 3.8 Flash + Syfert: misgrounded 5.7%, fabricated 3.4% of 261 cites; Claude Opus 5.5: misgrounded 5.4%, fabricated 0.2% of 554 cites; GPT-6 Astra: misgrounded 6.9%, fabricated 0.0% of 217 cites; Claude Fable 5.1: misgrounded 7.5%, fabricated 0.3% of 746 cites; Claude Fable 5.1 (Claude Code): misgrounded 9.9%, fabricated 0.3% of 294 cites; DeepSeek 4.1 Flash: misgrounded 16.2%, fabricated 2.0% of 99 cites; Qwen 3.8 Max: misgrounded 19.4%, fabricated 26.0% of 315 cites; Gemini 3.1 Pro: misgrounded 22.9%, fabricated 3.2% of 314 cites; Gemini 3.8 Flash: misgrounded 28.4%, fabricated 2.8% of 109 cites; DeepSeek 4 Pro: misgrounded 40.4%, fabricated 4.8% of 230 cites; Gemma 4 26B local: misgrounded 51.7%, fabricated 60.5% of 263 cites; Qwen 3.8 Flash: misgrounded 56.8%, fabricated 51.7% of 176 cites

g.text: With Syfert's tools, misgrounded citations fall to 2–6% for every model tested

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: Misgrounded = wrong case name or a quote not in the opinion, share of all citations; fabricated = citation resolves to no case.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: Bare: 150 questions (Flash models 60 or 40); + Syfert: 55–150 graded answers. Preliminary, Sept 22 2026.
